tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H = 0.16–0.48, while the target horizon is 23. A slow-horizon probe is needed to distinguish endogenous adaptation and reversal from mechanisms that agree over the short window.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow component reliably at H = 23.
Long-horizon observations are more directly discriminating for the suspected reversal.
It can explain short-window gain but cannot establish whether slow reversal occurs.
